label: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-24GT4SFP-P-V2
description: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-24GT4SFP-P-V2 - 28-port Layer 2 cloud-managed PoE switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 all PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at, 370 W budget) and 4x 1GE SFP uplinks. 56 Gbps switching capacity, 41.66 Mpps, one fixed fan, 21 W with no PoE load and 443 W at a full PoE load.

poe.note: Datasheet: 'PoE Out standard - PoE/PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at)', 'PoE budget - 370 W'.

notes: Datasheet: 'Number of PoE/PoE+ Out ports 24', 'PoE budget 370 W' across 24 ports is 15.4 W average - a rack of 30 W 802.3at cameras exhausts the budget long before it exhausts the ports. 'Maximum power consumption 21 W (with no PoE load) / 443 W (with full PoE load)', '1 x fixed fan' (not hot-swappable), 440 x 215 x 44 mm, 3 kg. Management is web/cloud only: the datasheet lists SSH 'No', with HTTP/HTTPS login, eWeb, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and Ruijie Cloud / Reyee App. Layer 2 only - 'IPv4 static route No', 'DHCP server No'; 4094 VLANs, 8000 MAC address entries, 9216-byte jumbo frames. Port names ge1..ge24 / sfp1..sfp4 are the catalogue's naming convention for a web-managed access switch; the datasheet states port counts (24 RJ45, 4 optical), not names.
